name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 24 times in 9 visits over 67 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 47 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.8 days starting 2026-04-27, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
